description: This file defines a React component that provides Android back button handling functionality within a React application. It creates and manages a context for back button event listeners, ensures proper use within provider components, and sets up fallback behavior for exiting the app based on user confirmation preferences.

classes.name: BackHandlerContextData
classes.description: Type alias for the back handler event listener function, obtained from WebApplication.

classes.name: BackHandlerContext
classes.description: React Context holding back handler event listener functions or null.

classes.name: ChildrenProps
classes.description: Type for component children, wrapping ReactNode.

classes.name: ProviderProps
classes.description: Props for the provider component, including application instance and children.

classes.name: MemoizedChildren
classes.description: Memoized React component to optimize rendering of children.

classes.name: AndroidBackHandlerProvider
classes.description: Main React component that provides back button handling behavior and context.

methods.name: useAndroidBackHandler
methods.description: Custom hook to access back handler functions from context, throws error if used outside provider.
